description_good_justification: The README opens with what the package is: a ROS 2 Jazzy C++ workspace (nav_utils: velocity limiter, battery monitor, safety zones, pure pursuit) built to show a complete quality pipeline.
interact_justification: README: obtaining (clone, make targets, container), feedback (GitHub issues with templates), contributing (CONTRIBUTING.md).
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/wansiedler/perfect_ros2_atomic_package/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md - Conventional Commits, pre-commit hooks, 80 % patch coverage, clang-format/clang-tidy clean.
documentation_basics_justification: https://github.com/wansiedler/perfect_ros2_atomic_package/blob/main/README.md - what is in here, building, running the tests locally and in a container, running the node.
documentation_interface_justification: https://github.com/wansiedler/perfect_ros2_atomic_package/blob/main/README.md#running-the-node lists the node's topics and parameters; every public class in src/nav_utils/include/nav_utils/ carries interface documentation on its methods (inputs, outputs, units).
english_justification: Documentation, commits and discussion are in English.
maintained_justification: Actively maintained: commits and releases in the last week, all issues and pull requests answered.
repo_track_justification: git; every change is a reviewed pull request with a Conventional Commit message, so the history says who changed what and why.
repo_interim_justification: Every merged pull request is on main immediately; releases are tagged from it by release-please.
version_unique_justification: Semantic version tags (nav_utils-vX.Y.Z) created by release-please from the Conventional Commits; the version is also written to package.xml.
version_semver_justification: SemVer, derived from the commit types (feat -> minor, fix -> patch, breaking change -> major).
release_notes_justification: https://github.com/wansiedler/perfect_ros2_atomic_package/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md - generated per release from the Conventional Commits, also shown on each GitHub release.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known vulnerabilities to date. The release notes list every fix; a security fix carries its advisory in the commit and lands under Bug Fixes.
report_responses_justification: Single maintainer; every issue and pull request so far has been answered.
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests are answered and triaged in the issue tracker.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: SECURITY.md commits to an initial response within the stated time; no report received yet.
build_justification: CMake/ament via colcon; `make build` wraps it.
build_floss_tools_justification: GCC or clang, CMake, colcon, ROS 2 Jazzy - all FLOSS; CI builds with both compilers.
test_justification: gtest suites for every class and a launch_testing integration test of the node; `make test` (colcon test).
test_invocation_justification: `make test` / `colcon test`, the standard ROS 2 invocation.
test_most_justification: 100 % line and function coverage on main (Codecov, badge in README); Codecov requires 80 % patch coverage on every pull request.
test_policy_justification: https://github.com/wansiedler/perfect_ros2_atomic_package/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md - new or changed logic must be covered; the Codecov patch status (80 %) is a required check.
tests_are_added_justification: Every functional change lands with tests, e.g. https://github.com/wansiedler/perfect_ros2_atomic_package/pull/34 (tests added until coverage reached 100 %).
warnings_justification: -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic plus hardening flags; the CI `compilers` job builds with WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=ON on gcc and clang.
warnings_fixed_justification: Warnings are errors in CI, so none can be merged.
warnings_strict_justification: -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror, C++23; clang-tidy with warnings as errors on top.
know_secure_design_justification: The maintainer applies least privilege and defence in depth throughout: workflows deny all permissions by default, every dependency is pinned by hash, releases are signed with provenance, inputs are validated (non-finite values rejected in the controllers).
know_common_errors_justification: C/C++ memory-safety errors, injection and the CWE/SANS Top 25 are the classes CodeQL security-and-quality, Semgrep, the sanitizers and the fuzzers are run against on every pull request; findings are fixed before merge.
crypto_published_justification: The software implements no cryptography and stores no credentials or passwords. (Release signing uses Sigstore/cosign in CI, not in the software.)
crypto_call_justification: The software implements no cryptography and stores no credentials or passwords. (Release signing uses Sigstore/cosign in CI, not in the software.)
crypto_floss_justification: The software implements no cryptography and stores no credentials or passwords. (Release signing uses Sigstore/cosign in CI, not in the software.)
crypto_keylength_justification: The software implements no cryptography and stores no credentials or passwords. (Release signing uses Sigstore/cosign in CI, not in the software.)
crypto_working_justification: The software implements no cryptography and stores no credentials or passwords. (Release signing uses Sigstore/cosign in CI, not in the software.)
crypto_weaknesses_justification: No cryptography, no credentials, no network protocol of its own: communication is the ROS 2 middleware the deployment configures.
crypto_pfs_justification: The software implements no cryptography and stores no credentials or passwords. (Release signing uses Sigstore/cosign in CI, not in the software.)
crypto_password_storage_justification: The software implements no cryptography and stores no credentials or passwords. (Release signing uses Sigstore/cosign in CI, not in the software.)
crypto_random_justification: The software implements no cryptography and stores no credentials or passwords. (Release signing uses Sigstore/cosign in CI, not in the software.)
delivery_mitm_justification: Sources and releases are served over https from GitHub; release assets are signed with cosign and carry SLSA provenance.
delivery_unsigned_justification: Every release asset ships a Sigstore signature bundle and build provenance; verification commands are in the release workflow and README.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No publicly known vulnerabilities to date; Dependabot (daily), OSV-Scanner and Trivy (every pull request and weekly) would surface one.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: None to date; the process above applies.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: gitleaks runs as a pre-commit hook and over the full history in CI; GitHub secret scanning with push protection is enabled.
static_analysis_justification: clang-tidy (warnings as errors), cppcheck, cpplint, CodeQL security-and-quality, Semgrep and SonarCloud run on every pull request; a release cannot be cut from an unanalysed commit.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL security-and-quality and Semgrep (p/default, p/c, p/secrets) look for vulnerability patterns specifically.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Findings land in GitHub code scanning; medium and higher are fixed before merge, see the closed alerts.
static_analysis_often_justification: On every pull request and push to main, plus weekly scheduled runs.
dynamic_analysis_justification: Sanitizers, Valgrind and fuzzing run on every pull request, so on every commit a release is cut from.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: ASan+UBSan, TSan and Valgrind memcheck on every pull request; ClusterFuzzLite fuzzing of the controllers.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Tests and sanitizer builds are Debug builds with assert() and _GLIBCXX_ASSERTIONS enabled.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No outstanding dynamic-analysis findings; any would block the pull request.
code_of_conduct_justification: https://github.com/wansiedler/perfect_ros2_atomic_package/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md - Contributor Covenant 2.1 with an enforcement contact.
access_continuity_justification: Single maintainer; GOVERNANCE.md#continuity states it and what a handover needs. Met once a second owner is added.
documentation_quick_start_justification: https://github.com/wansiedler/perfect_ros2_atomic_package/blob/main/README.md#running-the-tests-in-a-container - make docker-test, no ROS on the host needed.
documentation_current_justification: Documentation and Makefile targets are the same commands CI runs; a drift fails CI. Known-stale text is treated as a defect and fixed.
documentation_achievements_justification: https://github.com/wansiedler/perfect_ros2_atomic_package/blob/main/README.md - Scorecard and Best Practices badges at the top.
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: No user interface; the documentation is plain Markdown on GitHub.
internationalization_justification: The software produces no text for end users; the node exchanges numeric messages.
coding_standards_enforced_justification: clang-format, clang-tidy, cpplint, cppcheck, ruff, cmake-lint, shellcheck, yamllint, markdownlint, actionlint in pre-commit and in CI; ament_lint as tests.
build_standard_variables_justification: CMake: CC/CXX/CFLAGS/CXXFLAGS/LDFLAGS are honoured; the project appends its warning and hardening flags, it never replaces the user's.
build_preserve_debug_justification: No stripping; Debug builds keep symbols, the Debian package ships a -dbgsym companion.
build_non_recursive_justification: One CMake project, one target graph.
build_repeatable_justification: https://github.com/wansiedler/perfect_ros2_atomic_package/blob/main/docs/reproducible-build.md - two clean builds are bit-for-bit identical, `make reproducible` checks it.
installation_common_justification: `colcon build` installs into install/; a Debian package (ros-jazzy-nav-utils) ships with every release for apt/dpkg install and removal.
installation_standard_variables_justific: CMake install honours DESTDIR and CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX.
installation_development_quick_justifica: https://github.com/wansiedler/perfect_ros2_atomic_package/blob/main/README.md#running-the-tests-in-a-container - make docker-shell or the devcontainer: toolchain, dependencies, tests, in one command.
external_dependencies_justification: https://github.com/wansiedler/perfect_ros2_atomic_package/blob/main/src/nav_utils/package.xml (rosdep keys) and the SPDX SBOM attached to every release.
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependabot (daily, grouped), OSV-Scanner and Trivy on every pull request and weekly, SBOM scanned at release time.
updateable_reused_components_justificati: No vendored copies: every dependency comes from apt/rosdep or is a pinned action; an update is a pin change.
interfaces_current_justification: C++23 with clang-tidy modernize checks; current rclcpp API; no deprecated calls (compiler warnings are errors).
automated_integration_testing_justificat: GitHub Actions on every push and pull request; JUnit XML and the CI report record success or failure per test.
regression_tests_added50_justification: Every bug fix lands with its regression test, e.g. the NaN handling in PurePursuit (https://github.com/wansiedler/perfect_ros2_atomic_package/commit/d5358e7) with its test.
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: No cryptography, no credentials, no network protocol of its own: communication is the ROS 2 middleware the deployment configures.
crypto_credential_agility_justification: No cryptography, no credentials, no network protocol of its own: communication is the ROS 2 middleware the deployment configures.
crypto_used_network_justification: No cryptography, no credentials, no network protocol of its own: communication is the ROS 2 middleware the deployment configures.
crypto_tls12_justification: No cryptography, no credentials, no network protocol of its own: communication is the ROS 2 middleware the deployment configures.
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: No cryptography, no credentials, no network protocol of its own: communication is the ROS 2 middleware the deployment configures.
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: No cryptography, no credentials, no network protocol of its own: communication is the ROS 2 middleware the deployment configures.
signed_releases_justification: https://github.com/wansiedler/perfect_ros2_atomic_package/blob/main/docs/security.md#verifying-a-release - keyless cosign signatures and SLSA provenance on every asset; no private key exists to leak.
version_tags_signed_justification: release-please creates the tags through the GitHub API, unsigned. The release assets are signed instead.
input_validation_justification: Every public entry point validates its inputs (non-finite, out-of-range, empty path); see docs/security.md and the tests for the rejected cases.
hardening_justification: https://github.com/wansiedler/perfect_ros2_atomic_package/blob/main/src/nav_utils/CMakeLists.txt - -fstack-protector-strong, -fstack-clash-protection, -fcf-protection=full, _GLIBCXX_ASSERTIONS, _FORTIFY_SOURCE=3, full RELRO, noexecstack, on by default.
copyright_per_file_justification: Every source file starts with the copyright line; scripts/check_spdx.py enforces it in pre-commit.
license_per_file_justification: Every source file carries SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0; scripts/check_spdx.py enforces it in pre-commit.
two_person_review_justification: One maintainer; every change is reviewed, but by its author.
test_branch_coverage80_justification: 98 % branch coverage with gcov exception edges excluded (lcov, Codecov).
hardened_site_justification: Project site and repository are on github.com, which serves HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options and X-Frame-Options.
